FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Apex Audio & Visual Solutions specializes in the retail sale and rental of high-quality audio and visual equipment, including televisions, speakers, amplifiers, and projectors. Our operations include providing exceptional installation, service, and repair performed by certified technicians, ensuring all equipment is maintained and tested regularly to prevent malfunctions. We operate from a dedicated storefront located in Los Angeles, equipped with security measures to protect our inventory. We also facilitate online sales with secure payment processing, aiming to deliver reliable A/V solutions for both personal and corporate events. Our focus on customer satisfaction and product quality positions us as a trusted partner for all audio and visual needs.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On January 10, 2023, a customer returned a projector that had suffered water damage while in transit back to our store. The estimated cost of repair was $1,200. The incident was reported and we processed the repair, which is currently underway.
